title: VaultNode
description: locate's codomain (and the element of browse's frontier): one node of the vault proof tree. The meaningful proof path (slugs only, joints elided), its own slug, its role (morphism = a gerund, object = a codomain, joint = a `content/` holder), and whether the canonical `slug/slug.md` document is present. The optional title/description/tags are read from the document's frontmatter through the markdown codec. This is `attend`'s structural shadow  -  a vault node reached by navigating the namespace, not a settled meme. $id is the bare package-rooted descent path.

address.description: the meaningful proof path (slugs only, joints elided), e.g. "mark/utterance"

slug.description: the node's own slug (basename of its directory)

role.description: morphism (a gerund), object (a codomain), or joint (a `content/` holder)

hasDocument.description: whether the canonical `slug/slug.md` document is present

title.description: the node's title, from frontmatter (when documented)

description.description: the node's description, from frontmatter (when documented)

tags.description: the node's tags, from frontmatter (when documented)
